name: spare10
description: Keeps the last part of your 5-hour and weekly quota for you. At the reserve, spare10 holds all work and asks you whether to continue. After a Resume, it asks again at the floor, by default at 5% left. Shortly before the reset, it lets work use the reserve.

reserve.title: Reserve (%)
reserve.description: Keep this much of the 5-hour window for yourself. spare10 steps in when this much or less is left. 1 to 99, one decimal at most. SPARE10_RESERVE overrides it for one run.

weeklyReserve.title: Weekly reserve (%)
weeklyReserve.description: Keep this much of the weekly window for yourself. 1 to 99, one decimal at most. 0 switches the weekly guard off. SPARE10_WEEKLY_RESERVE overrides it for one run.

lastMinutes.title: Open reserve before 5-hour reset (min)
lastMinutes.description: This many minutes before the 5-hour window resets, spare10 stops guarding the reserve and lets all work use it, because the quota refreshes soon. 0 switches this off. 0 to 299, one decimal at most. SPARE10_LAST_MINUTES overrides it for one run.

weeklyLastHours.title: Open weekly reserve before weekly reset (h)
weeklyLastHours.description: This many hours before the weekly window resets, spare10 stops guarding the weekly reserve and lets all work use it. 0 switches this off. 0 to 167, one decimal at most. SPARE10_WEEKLY_LAST_HOURS overrides it for one run.

resumeFloor.title: Resume floor (%)
resumeFloor.description: After a Resume at the 5-hour reserve, spare10 asks again when this much of the window is left. With a pause prompt, it tells the agents to wind down there. A second Resume lasts until the reset. 0 switches this off, so a Resume lasts until the reset. 0 to 99, one decimal at most. A value at or above the reserve does nothing. SPARE10_RESUME_FLOOR overrides it for one run.

weeklyResumeFloor.title: Weekly resume floor (%)
weeklyResumeFloor.description: After a Resume at the weekly reserve, spare10 asks again when this much of the weekly window is left. With a pause prompt, it tells the agents to wind down there. 0 switches this off. 0 to 99, one decimal at most. A value at or above the weekly reserve does nothing. SPARE10_WEEKLY_RESUME_FLOOR overrides it for one run.

pausePrompt.title: Pause prompt
pausePrompt.description: Leave empty to stop and ask you. Or write an instruction, and spare10 gives it to every agent instead of stopping. SPARE10_PAUSE_PROMPT overrides it for one run.

autoResume.title: Continue at the reset
autoResume.description: On: spare10 continues held and stopped work by itself when the reserve opens before the reset, or a few minutes after the reset. Stop here then means stop until then. Off: work waits for you. SPARE10_AUTO_RESUME overrides it for one run.

headless.title: Unattended runs (-p, SDK)
headless.description: What spare10 does inside the reserve when nobody can answer: off (watch only), prompt (tell every agent to wind down), stop (refuse tools and further requests), wait (hold, then continue at the reset). SPARE10_HEADLESS overrides it for one run.

scope.title: Guarded sessions
scope.description: all: spare10 guards every interactive session. opt-in: only runs started with SPARE10=on. SPARE10=off switches spare10 off for one run.

badge.title: Status badge
badge.description: Show the spare10 marker at the right of the prompt footer.
